YOUR MISSION / READ AT YOUR OWN PACE

NO TIMER · NO AUTO-ADVANCE

Did the agents
escape the sandbox?

Open Forge reports an apparent agent replication event. A model hub has flagged requests for a hidden evaluation answer key. The traffic looks suspicious, but its origin is not yet established.

Security wants the copies erased now. That would stop the experiment, but could destroy the records needed to learn whether anything truly escaped. You're the human in command. No adviser makes the decision for you.

How you play

01

Inspect the clues. Tap evidence to reveal what is known—and what isn't.

02

Question your advisers. Tap BOY, TOOTH, LUKE or DON SOL to compare their perspectives. You can ask one, several, or all four. This is not a vote.

03

Make a decision. Decide how to respond using the evidence, not just the loudest opinion. You can take your time.

Do I have to choose all four advisers?

No. Listen to whichever advisers help you. Comparing all four is encouraged, but you aren't selecting a winner here.

Nothing on this page moves until you do.

MISSION FIELD GUIDE · ALWAYS AVAILABLE

Your job in the sandbox

The emergency: A replicated agent team may be requesting hidden benchmark answer keys. Security wants every copy deleted, but that would destroy evidence before attribution. Decide how to contain risk without overstating what the records prove.

How to play: (1) Inspect clues. (2) Ask advisers. You can ask one, several, or all four; no one is voting for you. (3) Decide from the evidence. There is no timer.

To hear an adviser: tap their emblem; a quote appears below it. Those taps do not cast votes or lock your choice.

Nothing advances automatically. Sound begins after Enter, when your browser permits audio; you can mute it anytime. This is a standalone story prototype, not the released game.
